title: Web-ImageGen project context and non-negotiable constraints
summary: Pilot project: browser-based image generation on the user's own account; product repo, local checkout, and hard collaboration boundaries set by the project owner.
content: Goal: 调用用户浏览器生图，不占用订阅额度（用户浏览器内完成生图，不消耗平台订阅额度）。Product repo: https://github.com/yann9596/Web-ImageGen.git, default branch main; local product repo: D:\AI\projects\opencode-web-imagegen. Non-negotiable constraints: (1) never clean, overwrite, commit, or discard the product repo's current uncommitted and untracked content; (2) product tasks run in an independent worktree; (3) product code writes are owned solely by Software Engineer; (4) Canonical Memory writes are owned solely by Context Engineer; (5) QA must not modify the implementation and then self-PASS; (6) no Neo4j, no full-chat vectorization, no fully automatic merge; (7) final merge is reserved for a human. Memory entry point for this team: D:\AI\multica-memory (in_place), canonical units under memory/, rebuildable SQLite FTS index at index/memory.db; RAG V1 uses SQLite FTS plus metadata and limited relations, and embedding remains interface-only (not enabled, no model selected). Platform permissions are not hard isolation; non-implementation-role write restrictions are enforced first by Instructions, with real hard boundaries (separate Git credentials, branch protection, ACLs, MCP/runtime tool isolation) to be added separately.
